state.paragraph: On October 1, 2013, representatives of Mac-Gray management, along with representatives from BofA Merrill Lynch and representatives from CSC/Pamplona attended a meeting at the Boston offices of Goodwin Procter for purposes of conducting confirmatory business due diligence. Representatives of Mac-Gray, Goodwin Procter, BofA Merrill Lynch and representatives of CSC/Pamplona and Kirkland participated in various telephone conference calls over the subsequent days to finalize business and legal due diligence.
